summary: Completed testing of BANIBS Social World - Last Used World Persistence Feature. All 9 test cases passed. localStorage key 'banibs:last_world' correctly persists across navigation and page refreshes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Last Used World persistence feature fully functional. localStorage key 'banibs:last_world' is used. Default value is 'community'. Each world page calls useWorldPersistence hook on mount.

test_1_socialworld_page_loads.details: Social World page loads correctly with hero title, world cards, and dropdown

test_6_socialworld_shows_last_used_indic.details: When localStorage is 'shortform', ShortForm card shows 'Last used' indicator and dropdown shows 'World: ShortForm'

test_7_clicking_world_cards_navigates_an.details: Clicking Circles card navigates to /portal/social/circles and sets localStorage to 'circles'

test_8_page_refresh_preserves_selection.details: After setting localStorage to 'chat' and refreshing, dropdown shows 'World: ChatSphere' and ChatSphere card shows 'Last used'

test_9_dropdown_navigation_works.details: Clicking ShortForm in dropdown navigates to /socialworld/shortform and updates localStorage

test_10_first_visit_defaults_to_communit.details: When localStorage is empty, defaults to 'community' with 'Last used' indicator on Community card

useWorldPersistence_hook.status: Correctly implemented with try-catch for SSR/incognito safety
